note:
3349 -> 3341: thirteen XML data files that landed non-canonical after 610e9753476 banked the floor, formatted with the gate's own fixer.

THE FLOOR WAS NOT STALE AND THE +5 WAS NOT DRIFT IN THE FLOOR -- both were checked before anything was formatted. 610e9753476 re-measures 3349 exactly, so the floor described its own tree correctly; HEAD measured 3354. Diffed by NAME rather than by count (section 4), because the count hid far more movement than it showed: 47 files entered the set and 42 left it, and 34 of those 89 are six module renames that changed no XML at all -- account_payment to account_payment_provider (14), base_automation to automation (8), base_geolocalize to geocoding (4), base_iban to account_iban (3), base_address_extended to partner_address_extended (3), base_vat to account_vat (2). A seventh, survey/data/survey_demo_certification.xml to survey/demo/, moves 60-odd attribute-order violations between paths without touching one of them.

What is left after the renames cancel is new code that landed non-canonical: documents_product (8, a new module assembled partly out of product/ and documents/), account/wizard/account_tax_merge_wizard_views.xml, account/views/account_payment_channel_views.xml, and partner/views/ir_ui_menu_views.xml. Those thirteen are formatted here; sale_mrp (3) and product (2) had already left the set on their own, which is why 3354 - 13 is 3341 and not 3346.

    before -> after
    lint_xml_unformatted   3354 -> 3341   (floor was 3349)
    lint_xml_field_order    791 -> 789    (floor 789, now exact)
    lint_xml_attrib_order  2455 -> 2454   (floor 2454, now exact)

The other two floors are NOT moved and did not need to be: one file,
account/wizard/account_tax_merge_wizard_views.xml, carried the whole of both
drifts (+2 field order, +1 attribute order) and _sort_xml_records.py on that one
file returns each to the number its own baseline commit reproduces -- 34d064426d3
measures 789 and 6b2e41012d6 measures 2454.

Content identity was re-asserted per file against _xml_identity.comparable on top
of the fixer's internal is_faithful round-trip. It holds for all thirteen formats.
It does NOT hold across sort_xml_file, and must not: that fixer reorders elements
by design. The one file that is both formatted and sorted was iterated to a fixed
point (format, sort, format, then neither changes), so it cannot sit in the
unsettled set the sweep reports. Its ir.actions.server code field is the only
whitespace-sensitive text among the thirteen; it was compiled after the reflow.
